svg.title: Paid entry price for Flutter crash reporting tools
svg.desc: Bar chart of published paid entry prices as of November 2026, checked Nov 4, 2026. Firebase Crashlytics is $0 with no paid tier. Sentry Team is $26 a month when billed annually, $312 a year, and the page structured data lists $29 a month. Embrace Pro is $0.80 per 1,000 sessions with a minimum of $80 a month. Bugsnag is not plotted because the pricing page does not print a fixed dollar amount for Select or Preferred.
svg.text: As of November 2026. Checked Nov 4, 2026. Dollars only, so the units match.
No paid tier on Spark or Blaze
Annual card price. JSON-LD monthly is $29
Bugsnag is not on this chart
Free is $0 for 1 user, 7,500 events, and 1 million spans a month. Select and Preferred
are volume sliders. The static page prints "STARTING AT $0" and no fixed dollar
for a paid tier, so this guide does not invent one.
Sources: firebase.google.com/pricing, sentry.io/pricing (Team annual $312 in structured data), embrace.io/pricing, bugsnag.com/pricing. Checked Nov 4, 2026.
Sentry Developer stays at $0 and is not the paid entry. Crashlytics custom logs are still limited to 64 kB.
